purpose: Prospective paired test of horizontal output in the first two seconds of native radio recovery; registration precedes independent paired scores.
mask: Drop all native radio in [25-L,25); retain IMU and all eligible post-return packets. No new ground-truth alignment, accelerometer bias or reset at recovery.
primary: Time/sample RMS of Euclidean horizontal error in [25,27), metres, against native spatial ground truth. Pair within recording, outage, initial state, packet queue, and scoring support. No artificial yaw error in the primary test.
kinematics: All outage lengths end at the same time in a recording. Use the last state available at each scoring time, never interpolate estimates using future radio. Apply one fixed body/tag convention per dataset to all arms.

arms.K: Immutable original lifted capture+tracker for native TWR, or Oursland original for native TDoA. Declare transfer adapters separately.
arms.C: Independent past-radio constant-velocity translation candidate. If unavailable use K; report availability and unconditional C separately when feasible.
arms.guarded: Output K heading throughout. During [25,27) use C only after two distinct consecutive non-overlapping validation blocks prefer its prediction on a common fixed sensor-loss scale. Otherwise return K. Outside the first two seconds output the exact K trajectory.

frozen_candidate: 250 ms blocks, rolling 1 s past raw-radio CV fit with height and velocity as nuisance/estimated variables; first two blocks initialization; same native directed range or range-difference, carrier lever arm and common measurement sigma for both predictive scores. No posterior fusion or truth in selection. Report switchback jump. No alternative thresholds selected after scoring.
second_candidate_before_independent_scor: B is an independent, separately reported geometric bound, motivated by original lifted packet 1-4 and 20 s baseline tails. At each K emission [25,27), project only its XY onto a containing disk (TWR) or one supporting halfspace of the height-marginalized hyperbolic branch (TDoA), sequentially in native time order. Only arrived, last packet per directed channel in past 0.25 s, nonnegative time. Fixed 3 native sensor standard deviations; absorb the full lever norm without trusting K heading, and conservatively allow 10 m/s body displacement times packet age (twice for TDoA). Reject impossible TDoA separation or nonpositive TWR. Keep Z, velocity, attitude, covariance and filter recursion at K; later identity is a design choice. No combined or winner-selected estimator. Exact XY nonincrease is conditional on the true position satisfying the inequalities; it is not a stochastic guarantee. Record feasibility diagnostics when GT is available for scoring only.
mechanism_only: Delft 2021-02-12 six late native TWR flights and original manuscript ten-second mask, controlled same-state ablations
Toronto UTIL const1-trial4-tdoa2 and const2-trial4-tdoa3, initial 0 and 180 degrees; tests update geometry, not independent performance
test_strata: Delft six late TWR, fixed duration sweep; known domain, not new across-site evidence by itself
Toronto UTIL trial2 all available constellations and both TDoA modes, distinct recordings: timestamps do not establish collection date
Delft native TDoA, first six chronologically for decoding only and last six unchanged including files labelled BAD; separate physical site and a transfer of the author algorithm
External native TWR if sensor frames, anchor survey, causal startup and file access can be verified independently of test scores. Log all prespecified eligible/excluded records with reasons.
independence: Equal weight per flight; four lengths on one recording are paired stress tests, not four independent flights. Never pool incompatible hardware/observation modalities to manufacture a win. Report per-domain and per-duration baselines, paired median differences and win/tie/loss; keep failures visible.
success: Stable superiority requires a positive median paired early XY benefit at each duration in each claimed domain, more improved than unchanged-or-worse recording-by-duration pairs, and no deterioration after the recovery window. Report ties exactly; a guard that never intervenes does not win. Report absolute and relative magnitudes, outliers and support; this criterion is descriptive, not population significance.
late_identity: For a two-second output-only shadow exact agreement after two seconds is a design identity; it cannot count as evidence for recovering a better long-term filter state.
manuscript: Do not change TeX without repeatable and practically meaningful improvement over native strong baselines.
